v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Dixit Dóminus * Dómino meo: Sede a dextris meis. ‡
text.en: The Lord said to my Lord: * Sit thou at my right hand. ‡

text.la: Magna ópera Dómini: * exquisíta in omnes voluntátes eius.
text.en: Great are the works of the Lord, * sought out according to all his wills.

text.la: Qui timet Dóminum, * in mandátis eius cupit nimis.
text.en: Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord; * he shall delight exceedingly in his commandments. ‡

text.la: Sit nomen Dómini * benedíctum in sǽcula.
text.en: Blessed be the name of the Lord * from henceforth now and for ever.

text.la: Deus autem noster * in cælo: ómnia quæcúmque vóluit, fecit.
text.en: But our God is in heaven, * he hath done all things whatsoever he would.

text.la: Fratres: Libénter suffértis insipiéntes, cum sitis ipsi sapiéntes: sustinétis enim si quis vos in servitútem rédigit, si quis dévorat, si quis áccipit, si quis extóllitur, si quis in fáciem vos cædit.
text.en: For you gladly suffer the foolish; whereas yourselves are wise. For you suffer if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take from you, if a man be lifted up, if a man strike you on the face.

text.la: Vobis datum est * nosse mystérium regni Dei, céteris autem in parábolis, dixit Iesus discípulis suis.
text.en: Jesus said to His disciples: * Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God, but to others in parables.

text.la: Deus, qui cónspicis, quia ex nulla nostra actióne confídimus: concéde propítius; ut, contra advérsa ómnia Doctóris géntium protectióne muniámur.
text.en: O God, Who seest that we put not our trust in anything that we do, mercifully grant that through the protection of the Teacher of the Gentiles we may be defended against all adversity.
